slots.visualIntent: One uninterrupted situation held across the full block: a person at seated height on the edge of a doorway, a corridor, or a path, with a hand on a chair arm or a foot at a step, and open ordinary space ahead that they are not taking. The camera stays close enough to the body to register the limit and wide enough to keep the possibility of movement in frame, and the stillness deepens as the questions accumulate rather than cutting away to illustrate them. Level, observational, no face required.
slots.searchQuery: person seated at doorway threshold still frame open space ahead long take

slots.visualIntent: One person alone in their own home across a continuous stretch of ordinary time: the body at the end of a routine, food prepared according to a plan rather than appetite, a notebook or calendar open beside them with the next things written down. Repetition, breath, and self-monitoring, all unspectacular. The three efforts appear as one continuous morning-to-evening rhythm rather than as three separate demonstrations.
slots.searchQuery: older adult alone home daily routine exercise notebook planning natural light

slots.visualIntent: The same person later in the day, at the same table the routine was built around, with the notebook, the prepared food, and the finished session all still present and now simply out of use. The materials of control remain fully intact while the person sits with them doing nothing, so the effort is visibly real and visibly insufficient. Nothing is lost on camera and nothing is gained; the frame simply lets the insufficiency stand.
slots.searchQuery: adult sitting at home table with notebook and meal untouched quiet daylight
